device.basis: Filter engine of X-T3 5.11, driver 0x1dba99c..0x1dbb344. Its open registers the handler 0x1dba954 on interrupt row 0x45 of table 0x13e6454 ({0x7f, 0xd0, 1, 1}: line 127). 0x1dbb1d4 writes the source and destination memory types at 0xfff4a710. It prepares the face detection picture and runs the still step TCUBEPR; the stock still capture does not reach it. The 2 ms run time at 54 MHz is a stand-in.
